scope: Property maintenance only (keep/modify/add/remove + cfg enablement). No TLC/tests executed; no spec/code edited.
reason: Three changes affect what the source guarantees. (1) Learners now answer and grant MsgVote/MsgPreVote (raft.go:924-972; TestLearnerCannotVote was renamed to TestLearnerCanVote). The grant clause of LearnerEligibility and the learner-silence clause of VoteContract are therefore stale. (2) newRaft and raft.restore now rebuild the full ConfState, including VotersOutgoing, LearnersNext and AutoLeave, using confchange.Restore plus assertConfStatesEquivalent (raft.go:360-367,1435-1446). JointSnapshotRecovery and ConfigurationOrigin used to detect the old projection loss; they are now plain obligations that must hold, and the TraceCorrespondence omission of ConfigurationOrigin is stale. The old restore membership check still omits VotersOutgoing (raft.go:1401-1413), and that now interacts with joint restore. (3) RawNode.Ready() now accepts the Ready immediately, and Advance no longer clears messages or read states (rawnode.go:119-177; TestRawNodeConsumeReady). The raw branch of ReadyOwnership is stale, and the lostReads observer in ReadyAccounting would raise false alarms. All other properties are kept, but their justification has to be rechecked under the new paths. The new properties are evidence-based and aimed at wrong interactions: stale-config candidates winning with learner votes, outgoing-only voters ignoring snapshots, and Advance dropping output produced after Ready. Revisions never weaken a property that is still promised.

entries.name: VoteDecisionEligibility_new

evidence.reference: old/spec/base.tla:639-655 (grant has ~o.learner; silence has (~stale /\ o.learner)), 785; StepVote base.tla:273-274
evidence.source: new/source/raft.go:924-972 (learners answer with a grant or reject using the same canVote/isUpToDate rule); raft.go:830-857 (lease and term handling unchanged)

entries.expression:
VoteContract_new(o) == LET m == o.message
  lease == m.term > o.term /\ ~m.forced /\ o.check /\ o.lead # 0 /\ o.elapsed < ElectionTick
  stale == m.term # 0 /\ m.term < o.term
  reset == ~lease /\ ~stale /\ m.term > o.term /\ m.type = "MsgVote"
  t == IF reset THEN m.term ELSE o.term
  v == IF reset THEN 0 ELSE o.vote
  lead == IF reset THEN 0 ELSE o.lead
  fresh == m.logTerm > o.lastTerm \/ (m.logTerm = o.lastTerm /\ m.index >= o.lastIndex)
  can == v = m.from \/ (v = 0 /\ lead = 0) \/ (m.type = "MsgPreVote" /\ m.term > t)
  grant == ~lease /\ ~stale /\ fresh /\ can
  silence == lease \/ (stale /\ m.type = "MsgVote")
  expected == IF silence THEN {} ELSE {[type |-> IF m.type = "MsgVote" THEN "MsgVoteResp" ELSE "MsgPreVoteResp", term |-> IF grant THEN m.term ELSE t, to |-> m.from, reject |-> ~grant, count |-> 1]}
IN /\ o.responses = expected /\ o.afterTerm = t /\ o.afterVote = IF grant /\ m.type = "MsgVote" THEN m.from ELSE v
VoteDecisionEligibility_new == \A o \in quality.votes : VoteContract_new(o)
entries.rationale: The only differences from VoteContract are that ~o.learner is removed from grant and (~stale /\ o.learner) is removed from silence. Every other decision is unchanged and still checked in both directions, so a learner must now respond exactly like a voter.
entries.cfg_placement: Replace VoteDecisionEligibility in base.cfg, MC.cfg, all 11 MC_hunt_*.cfg, Trace.cfg and TraceCorrespondence.cfg. Add it to Update_full.cfg and Update_focused.cfg, because vote handling is an updated path.

The candidate's config may be stale, too; but in that case it won't win the election, at least in the absence of the bug discussed in etcd#7625'; raft.go:899-912 + 1605-1611 (V2 conf entries do not block Hup); raft.go:1318-1327 (TimeoutNow skips the pending-conf check)

entries.expression:
LearnerVoteFreshness == \A w \in history.wins : \A g \in history.grants :
  (g.learner /\ ~g.pre /\ g.candidate = w.node /\ g.term = w.term /\ g.node \in w.yes \cap VoterIDs(w.config))

entries.observer_change: Add cfgHist |-> r.cfgHist to the grant record (StepVote) and to the win record (BecomeLeader).
entries.rationale: This states the source's own claim: a counted learner vote is legitimate only if the winner's applied config descends from the learner's config, which is the promotion case. A winner whose config is older than the learner's demotion is the stale-config hazard. Learner voting makes this hazard easier to reach because demoted nodes now grant. The property is more sensitive than ElectionSafety. A violation is a validation candidate (known etcd#7625 implementation issue vs model issue) and must not be removed.

covered_updated_behaviors.behavior: Joint ConfState (VotersOutgoing/LearnersNext/AutoLeave) restored at construction (newRaft from Storage.InitialState)
covered_updated_behaviors.explanation: JointSnapshotRecovery conj 1 compares history.recovery.config with expectedConfig (the snapshot or saved-app config) whenever outgoing # {}. ConfigurationOrigin requires config = ConfigOf(cfgHist) for every live node. JointConfigurationShape checks learnersNext ⊆ outgoing and that autoLeave implies joint, which is the shape confchange.checkInvariants enforces.
Restore sets cfgHist = s.hist. SnapshotBacking gives s.config = ConfigOf(s.hist), so JointSnapshotRecovery conj 2 and ConfigurationOrigin conj 1 fail if the restored tracker drops any joint field.

covered_updated_behaviors.behavior: Restored AutoLeave consumed by Advance on a (new) leader
covered_updated_behaviors.explanation: Eligibility is read from r.config.autoLeave, which can now be TRUE after a restore. Every eligible Advance must append the empty V2 leave entry or record a quota retry. AckPreservation allows exactly that one appended entry.

covered_updated_behaviors.behavior: Joint quorums after restore used by elections, commit, ReadIndex and CheckQuorum
covered_updated_behaviors.explanation: Wins and commitUses record the config actually used, and JointWon is checked over both halves. ReadBasis checks JointWon(confirmConfig, confirmAcks). A restore that silently became non-joint would show up as commits or wins justified by only the incoming half.

A granted MsgVoteResp from a learner is a published promise that PromiseOK backs with the durable hs.vote. VoteRecovery checks that the vote survives restart. QuorumAccounting/JointWon count a learner's vote only if the candidate's config lists it as a voter. ElectionSafety and LeaderCompleteness catch any unsafe win that results.

covered_updated_behaviors.behavior: Learners still cannot campaign or accept TimeoutNow
covered_updated_behaviors.explanation: The campaigns ghost records learner = id ∈ learners and must always be FALSE. CampaignContract ignores Hup from nodes outside the voter set.

covered_updated_behaviors.explanation: Accepted messages are still published only after the HS part is durable (PromiseBacking). Accepted ReadStates must reach application.reads (lostReads = {}).

covered_updated_behaviors.explanation: The model's config record already uses voters/outgoing. `out` is a Bag, so send order is not observable. CommittedIndex refactor equivalence is covered by the QuorumIndex oracle through QuorumAccounting/CommittedHistory. No property changes.

suspected_defects.kind: implementation (liveness/availability), now reachable with faithful joint restore
suspected_defects.description: raft.restore accepts a snapshot only if r.id ∈ cs.Voters ∪ cs.Learners. A follower that is only in VotersOutgoing, including LearnersNext nodes, ignores a newer valid snapshot and replies MsgAppResp{Index: committed}. Yet that node counts toward the outgoing majority, and confchange.Restore creates Progress for it. If the outgoing majority depends on it after compaction, joint commit and LeaveJoint can stall.
suspected_defects.must_not_hide: Do not shrink `member` to voters ∪ learners and do not drop the property. Validation decides between implementation and model.

suspected_defects.kind: implementation (acknowledged upstream, etcd#7625), amplified by this update
suspected_defects.description: Learners now grant votes to any up-to-date candidate that asks. A candidate whose applied config lags a committed demotion can count the demoted learner as a voter. This is possible because V2 conf entries do not block Hup (numOfPendingConf counts only EntryConfChange) and TimeoutNow skips the check. The source comment admits the stale-config case is safe only 'in the absence of the bug discussed in #7625'.
suspected_defects.must_not_hide: Do not restore learner silence in VoteContract_new, do not re-add the grant clause as a pruning device, and do not edit CampaignContract to ignore V2.

suspected_defects.description: Changer.Simple returns an empty config with a nil error when checkInvariants fails. That path is now on the newRaft/restore route through confchange.Restore/chain. assertConfStatesEquivalent mitigates it by turning a silent empty config into a panic. It is likely unreachable because apply preserves the invariants.
suspected_defects.must_not_hide: Report it if it is ever witnessed. Do not relax the equivalence.

suspected_defects.kind: model (expected stale draft behavior, to be fixed in the modeling phase, not by properties)
suspected_defects.description: The old model hard-codes the retired behaviors: RestoreProjection at restart and snapshot (base.tla:309-324,1226), the learner vote guard in StepVote (base.tla:274), RawNode read-only Ready in ProtocolReady (base.tla:970-976), and RawNode accept-at-Advance in AdvanceCore (base.tla:1087-1095). Until these are updated, JointSnapshotRecovery/ConfigurationOrigin/VoteDecisionEligibility_new/ReadyOwnership_new/AdvanceRetainsPostReadyOutput will report violations. Those are model issues, not reasons to edit the properties.
suspected_defects.must_not_hide: Fix the model, not the property.

Recheck the justification of preserved properties on the updated model, especially PromiseBacking/VoteRecovery with learner votes, QuorumAccounting/ReadBasis/AutoLeaveAdvance after joint restore, and RequestCorrelatedConfigurationEffects after the switchToConfig refactor.

Run every reachability canary (LearnerVoteGrantNotReached, LearnerVoteWinNotReached, JointRestartRecoveryNotExercised, JointSnapshotRestoreNotExercised, OutgoingOnlySnapshotNotReached, PostReadyOutputNotReached) to show the new and revised properties are not vacuous within the bounds. Increase bounds or workload (Joining node, AddLearner/AddVoter, Snapshot/Compact) if a canary is not witnessed.
The validation phase must classify any violation of SnapshotRecipientMembership (D1) and LearnerVoteFreshness/ElectionSafety (D2) as model, property or implementation.

The liveness targets (ElectionProgress for the promoted-learner scenario, CatchupProgress for D1, the new AutoLeaveProgress) are still unchecked. They need an unbounded service/liveness harness, and bounded MC with exhausted fault budgets is not evidence.

Decide whether NoUnexpectedFatal can be enabled in the Update cfgs (it depends on whether other fatal paths are reachable there). At minimum enable it in the joint-recovery hunt so restore panics are visible.

Trace side: map ConfState.Voters/VotersOutgoing in the instrumentation, record that RawNode acceptance happens at Ready, and capture new-source traces with learner MsgVoteResp and joint restore. With ConfigurationOrigin re-enabled in TraceCorrespondence.cfg, the old joint-recovery violation trace should no longer reproduce. Confirm this.

The model must represent confchange.Restore failures for ill-formed ConfStates (for example learners without voters, or AutoLeave without outgoing) as Fatal. restore_test.go only generates valid ConfStates, so that test is no evidence for the error cases.
